column4: Recorded runs and imported rankings with matching filenames no longer reuse each other's cached records.
Removed an unused internal row-label helper while preserving the existing detail labels and actions.
Removed an unused counter from statistics merging without changing totals or their accuracy labels.
Added a real archive round-trip check for matching filenames, preserved raw logs and safe cache reloads.
Recorded the preceding APK's delivery and the reproduced imported-history cache failure and fix.
I fixed an edge case where a history cache could display a recorded run in place of an imported ranking. The original logs remain untouched, and I removed two unused internal helpers.
